//: Spaces on Railway — the template, as the composer asks for it (SPA-190, ship-12).
Railway templates are composed in the dashboard (Templates → New Template) and have no
file format of their own; this file is the exact set of answers, one entry per composer
field, so the owner can build and publish the template without deciding anything, and so
a reviewer can diff it. Field names follow the composer's labels; `${{…}}` is Railway's
reference-variable syntax and is pasted verbatim.
Database: Railway's managed Postgres is a plain image and does not carry pgvector, so the
template provisions pgvector/pgvector:pg17 (pgvector 0.8.x; the migrations need >= 0.8)
as its own service on a volume — never Railway's stock Postgres, which fails at the first
migration. Ollama is not provisioned; local embeddings are opt-in and need a host of
The first-run setup token is printed to the app service's Deploy Logs:
`[setup] First-run setup token: …` — open the assigned URL at /setup and paste it.

DATABASE_URL.description: The pgvector Postgres this template provisions, over Railway's private network.

APP_URL.description: The domain Railway assigns to this service, https because Railway terminates TLS. Cookies are Secure only when this matches what the browser sees; change it to your custom domain if you attach one.

volumes.description: Blobs and the auto-generated secret.key. Lose `./data/secret.key` and every stored credential is unrecoverable. (On Railway, ./data is this volume, mounted at /data.)

PGDATA.description: A subdirectory, because Railway's volume root holds lost+found and initdb refuses a non-empty directory.
